annotations.title: Find federal leases that end soon

description:
Buildings and spaces GSA leases for federal agencies whose leases end soon (GSA's Inventory
    of Owned and Leased Properties, weekly, public domain): address, city, state, rentable square
    feet, the lease's start and end dates and days left, soonest first, with the count by state
    and by year. A lease ending is a renewal, a move or a new build-out: early work for janitorial,
    security, moving, furniture, cabling and construction firms nearby. The end date is a signal:
    GSA often extends or stays past it; the list names no tenant agency, owner or rent.

min_sqft.description: Smallest rentable area in square feet, e.g. 20000.
min_sqft.title: Min Sqft

months.description: Leases ending within this many months, 1-60 (default 24).
months.title: Months

q.description: Words in the building's name or street address.
q.title: Q
